title: Israeli tanks cross ‘yellow line’ boundary into Hamas-controlled central Gaza
summary_full: First incursion across boundary since ceasefire deal comes as Eisenkot seeks to form government without NetanyahuThe Israeli military crossed into Hamas-controlled central Gaza on Wednesday in its first ground operation across the “yellow line” boundary since a fragile ceasefire was agreed last October, forcing dozens of displaced Palestinians to flee their tents.Israeli tanks rolled along the Salah al-Din road, Gaza’s main north-south route, a day after the US-backed Board of Peace, a body overseeing the ceasefire, accused Israel and Hamas of failing to honour their commitments to end hostilities.
